name: 素白·留白
description: 源自 rico-md 的「素白·留白」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 28px 24px 60px 24px; font-family: Hiragino Sans, PingFang SC, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 2.2; color: {{muted}}; background-color: #fefefd; word-wrap: break-word; letter-spacing: 0.012em">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 300; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.8; margin: 40px 0 24px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-align: center">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: 300; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.8; margin: 36px 0 18px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding-left: 32px">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: #444444; line-height: 1.8; margin: 30px 0 14px; letter-spacing: 0.08em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: {{codeText}}; line-height: 2; margin: 24px 0 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: transparent; padding: 14px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0; font-weight: 400; color: {{codeText}}; letter-spacing: 0.08em">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 40px auto; border: none; width: 36px; height: 1px; background-color: #ddd">
